shortDescription: Polish interest rates will likely stay unchanged for one or two quarters, Monetary Policy Council Member Ireneusz Dabrowski told state news agency PAP in comments published on Tuesday, adding that after the first quarter of 2027 a rate cut is more likely than a rate hike.
